scope: Conditional uncertainty under the selected coupled mean, hard conductance band and quantized observation law; all model selection used these data

lag_exchange_refinement.fixed_value_source: The audited unconstrained reference point's log_rS coordinate, without an exp/log round trip
lag_exchange_refinement.warm_source: Nearest successful coarse profile point around 15 s after the entire coarse profile is terminal and independently audited
lag_exchange_refinement.reason: The restricted zero-loading theory permits exchange of sensor/input factors; the provisional coarse profile has a second low region near 15 s. Its fixed 15 s grid point does not resolve the sensor-time candidate near 14.79 s. Check that candidate before interpreting lag labels or a disconnected profile.
lag_exchange_refinement.gate: Preserve the original grid and every point. Independently audit the new point. If its nll improves the unconstrained reference by more than 0.001, refine the baseline before reporting likelihood-ratio values. Do not infer interval endpoints by interpolation.

lower_loading_sensitivity.reason: Repeated lower-bound sensor-loading estimates and the theoretical sensor/input lag exchange at zero loading; assess dependence on the original 0.005 lower bound before assigning physical lag identities.

residual_initial_sensitivity.reason: T1 correlation length is comparable to run length. Compare a stationary prior at the first scored point with the conditional likelihood given the actual first quantized observation; do not add that reading to nobs.

recovery.coverage_definition: Refit unconstrained and true-log-K constrained models for each generated record collection; fraction with twice-nll difference <= nominal chi-square-one cutoff. This empirically checks that cutoff with nuisance bounds, conditional on the generating model and design.
recovery.denominators: Retain every attempted draw, failure, retry and local-basin correction. Report coverage among complete draws, binomial Monte Carlo uncertainty and worst-case bounds counting failed draws either way.
recovery.expansion: No expansion to 200 until numerical convergence and the 50-draw diagnostic review justify it.
